q3map2's placeholder for a face the compiler could not texture, written into the shader lump of maps/oa_dm4.bsp; no OpenArena release ships an image for it. The closure walks the whole lump, which is the conservative reading, and the engine does not: R_LoadShaders only byte-swaps the flags, so a shader-lump entry reaches R_FindShader through ShaderForShaderNum alone, once per surface (ioq3 code/renderergl2/tr_bsp.c), and none of this BSP's 1,045 surfaces references the entry. Two other lumps can register a shader name independently of the shader lump, and neither names this one: a fog record carries its own shader string and R_LoadFogs registers that (this BSP has no fog volume), and R_LoadEntities registers 'remapshader' and 'vertexremapshader' worldspawn values through R_RemapShader, which this BSP has none of. So R_FindShader never runs for it, nothing renders through it, and the engine reports nothing - not even at PRINT_DEVELOPER
